hard_stop: NO clip enters the edit until every rights_gate field is filled with a verified value and human_legal_review=true for THAT clip.

gate_enforcement.test: fabricated cleared slot with NULL fields
gate_enforcement.rule: clearance_status='cleared' requires human_legal_review=true AND zero NULL rights fields

excluded_existing_short_clip.rule: EXCLUDED from all 8 slots - no hero, callback, montage filler or whole-video subject.

field_rules.verify: The exact first-party page where the asset is published, not a repost or a search result.
field_rules.pass: URL resolves on the rights-holder's own domain and the asset ID matches.
field_rules.fail: Aggregator, mirror, embed, social repost, or an unverifiable link.

field_rules.verify: The agency's own catalogue / asset identifier for this exact file.
field_rules.pass: A stable agency asset ID is recorded and matches the downloaded file.
field_rules.fail: Only a YouTube video ID, or no catalogue ID at all.

field_rules.verify: The written licence or public-domain statement covering THIS file, with its URL and retrieval date.
field_rules.pass: Licence text explicitly permits this use, including commercial use if monetization is intended.
field_rules.fail: Assumed 'public domain', 'educational use', 'fair use' as a licence, or a generic site-wide statement that excludes some media.

field_rules.verify: Whether the frame or audio contains anyone else's content (music, logo, broadcast graphic, another creator's footage).
field_rules.pass: Written 'none found' after frame + audio inspection, or a documented clearance for each item.
field_rules.fail: Uninspected, or contains uncleared third-party material.

field_rules.verify: Whether any identifiable person appears and what consent/permissions exist.
field_rules.pass: No identifiable person, or documented permission plus the required likeness/AI-likeness review.
field_rules.fail: Identifiable person with no documented permission.

field_rules.verify: Whether the person is a current agency employee/crew member shown in a way that could read as promotional.
field_rules.pass: Confirmed not current personnel, or written clearance from the agency.
field_rules.fail: Current crew / employee in promotional framing, or status unconfirmed.

field_rules.verify: Whether the asset is used to promote a product, service, or as cover art / thumbnail hero.
field_rules.pass: Editorial/educational context only, no promotional reading, no cover-art use.
field_rules.fail: Promotional or cover-art use of agency imagery or insignia.

field_rules.verify: Rights covering the ORIGINAL audio track if it is retained.
field_rules.pass: Native audio is licensed together with the picture, or audio is verified silent/own-recorded.
field_rules.fail: Retained audio with no separate rights basis, or substituted music/SFX.

field_rules.verify: Complete credit line required by the licence (title, author, source URL, licence, any change note).
field_rules.pass: Full credit string written and included on screen and in the description.
field_rules.fail: Name only, link only, or a generic 'credit to the owner'.

field_rules.verify: On-screen and spoken wording must not imply agency/person endorsement.
field_rules.fail: Title, caption or VO could be read as an endorsement.

field_rules.verify: Frame-by-frame check for agency insignia, logos, mission patches or branding.
field_rules.pass: Documented 'no insignia in the selected frames'.
field_rules.fail: Insignia visible, or check not performed.

field_rules.verify: Hash of the exact file that will enter the edit.
field_rules.pass: SHA-256 recorded after download and matching the final media file.
field_rules.fail: No hash, or hash of a different/transcoded file.

field_rules.verify: Exact selected in-point / out-point and duration.
field_rules.pass: Duration <= 10s on screen and the 8 clips together stay <= 80s / 600s (<=13.3%).
field_rules.fail: Longer excerpt, or the aggregate source share exceeds 13.3%.

field_rules.verify: V10-style 10-axis scout score for this specific clip.
field_rules.pass: Numeric score recorded with its rubric sheet.
field_rules.fail: No score, or a score copied from another clip.

field_rules.verify: The >=78 minimum pass threshold from the rubric.
field_rules.fail: True with a lower score, or set without a score.

field_rules.verify: Final status after every other field passes.
field_rules.pass: 'cleared' ONLY when all fields above are verified AND human_legal_review=true.

field_rules.verify: A human reviewer has actually reviewed this clip's rights chain.
field_rules.pass: true with reviewer name and date in the sign-off block.
field_rules.fail: true without a named reviewer/date, or set by an agent.

field_rules.verify: This ledger is a checklist, not legal advice.
field_rules.fail: false - would imply a legal opinion.

kill_conditions: Current named crew / employee in promotional framing or an official mission broadcast used as a source clip.
Agency insignia, mission patch, or logo visible in the selected frames.
Native audio or music retained without its own documented rights basis.
Asset obtained from a social repost, mirror, aggregator or embed instead of the rights holder.
Licence cannot be read for this exact file, or excludes commercial use while monetization is intended.
The V10/Short NASA water-bubble asset (any hero, callback, montage or whole-video use).
Any clip that would make the 8-source aggregate exceed 80s / 600s (13.3%).
Clips strung together with little or no narrative, or a mostly non-verbal reaction.

attribution_templates.template: Source: NASA / [mission or centre], "[asset title]", [asset ID]. NASA is credited; no endorsement implied. Licence: [agency media usage statement + URL, retrieved YYYY-MM-DD].
"[title]" by [author], [source URL], licensed CC BY [version]. Changes: cropped to <=10s, slowed to 0.5x/0.25x, no audio substitution. No endorsement implied.
"[title]", [agency], public domain per [statement URL, retrieved YYYY-MM-DD]. No endorsement implied.
Original footage shot for this episode by [operator], [date]. No third-party material.
"[title]" used with written permission from [rights holder], dated [date], reference [ID]. Permission alone does not establish reused-content eligibility.
